community.reason: Level 2: a specific external cadet sponsorship of limited reach (12 cadets) plus employee development programmes; the reach is not substantial enough for level 3.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: specific current internal inclusion practices and an industry diversity network role, with no reach figures beyond workforce demographics.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: only the company's own innovation and a strategic startup stake; there is no programme enabling founders or small businesses.

ai.notes: Final score = 0 + 12 + 8 + 3 = 23/100. Contradiction: the corporate governance section (p.38) says the 40% board gender target for 2025 is not met at 33%, while the Gender Balance Act table (p.71-72) states a 33% target that is met. The cadet programme also has 'four cadets' completing voyages, but that figure sits in a separate paragraph and was not used as an indicator. S3 Affected Communities was assessed as non-material. Coal appears only as a dry bulk cargo the company transports; it is not mining or coal power, so it is not a red flag. Whistleblower and harassment surveys are mentioned without any disclosed substantiated cases.
